verdict.rationale: Cua is software infrastructure for computer-use agents: virtual desktops (Spaces), a background app driver, VMs via Lume, an SDK and a benchmark suite. It ships no hardware rigs, so bills of materials, wiring and firmware flashing are outside its product category. Connecting a spare Mac or server you already own to run Spaces is host setup, not hardware assembly, and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As a power user, hardware rigs come with a bill of materials, wiring, and flashing steps I can follow end to end
